# MIJ Digital ENT

> High-performance digital assets, custom website development, personal branding, corporate identity, and automated business systems (CRM/POS/Web3) in Malaysia.

## Overview
MIJ Digital ENT is a boutique web development and digital solutions studio based in Southern Malaysia. Founded by a senior lecturer and tech enthusiast, MIJ Digital ENT specializes in building fast, modern, custom websites and web applications without rely-on generic WordPress templates.

## Main Services
- [Personal Branding Websites](https://mijdigital.my/services#personal): High-converting profile websites for professionals, agents, lecturers, advisors, and executives. (Starting from RM 999)
- [Corporate Branding Websites](https://mijdigital.my/services#corporate): Modern corporate digital identity, product showcases, and company profiles for SMEs. (Starting from RM 4,999)
- [Custom Business Systems](https://mijdigital.my/services#system): Management systems for rental management, POS, CRM, sales automation, clinic booking, and Web3 / dApp integrations.

## Key Features & Value Proposition
- 1 Year Free Domain (.com / .my) & Cloud Hosting included.
- 1 Year Free Technical Maintenance & Bug Fix Warranty.
- Rapid turnaround (Personal: 3-7 days | Corporate: 7-14 days).
- Flexible payment structure: 50% deposit to start, 50% upon delivery.
- AI-assisted modern tech stack ("Mixed-Mode" engineering) with zero bloated templates.
